Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>

Subject: Proposed three-wave pilot for technical deep-dive — availability & rotating slots

Hi Liam — thanks again for a really productive discovery earlier. A quick recap and a scheduling ask so we can lock the technical deep-dive with the right NovaCorp stakeholders.

Recap (very short):
- Goal: 60–75 minute technical deep-dive focused on inference runtime behavior, integration points, and a short Q&A.
- Audience you mentioned: platform eng (Evan), security (Aisha), and 2x backend leads.
- Success signals: confirm integration feasibility, identify any blocker, agree on next steps and owner.

Scheduling ask: because there are participants distributed across US / EU / APAC, we propose a three-wave pilot of rotating meeting windows so no single region always takes awkward hours. Suggested pilot options (times in UTC; conversions below):

Wave A (US morning friendly): Tue 2025-08-05 15:00 UTC (08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 16:00 BST)
Wave B (EU afternoon friendly): Wed 2025-08-06 13:00 UTC (06:00 PT / 09:00 ET / 14:00 BST / 22:00 SGT)
Wave C (APAC evening friendly): Thu 2025-08-07 02:00 UTC (19:00 PT previous day / 22:00 ET previous day / 03:00 AEST)

Plan: run the three-wave pilot across three separate calls (one per wave) the week of Aug 5; rotate who hosts/owns the follow-up notes so burden is shared.

Quick asks: can you please (a) confirm which of the three waves works for Evan and Aisha, (b) add any other stakeholders who must attend, and (c) tell us if you prefer we send calendar invites for all three and you pick, or you want us to only invite confirmed attendees.

Attachments: draft_agenda.pdf (short outline), availability_grid.png (visual matrix). I've also included a single .ics with the Wave A placeholder (pilot-ics.ics).

Thanks — happy to adjust windows if those UTC options are no good.

-Vivek
